exposure: Interval between cesarean section and second operation (for two-step surgery)
outcome: number of red blood cell (RBC) units transfused
cohort: 43 patients managed for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) between 2007 and 2023 at a single center
finding: The two-step surgical approach for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) was associated with a significantly lower number of RBC units transfused during surgery compared to the traditional one-step approach.
